cost: Query normalization O(text); routing global math cost under Limits5seconds then D coverage calls, stable O(D log D) sorting and attempted solvers plus log bytes. Trait callbacks can be arbitrary; access is metadata, not enforced authorization.
description: Independent three-level query routing: global exact math, finite-score domain selection, escalation value and decision log. No call to mlab exists.
forward: Query detects lowercase explanation substrings. route strips these phrases for global math; if successful clear why only in Answer mode. Otherwise score original query in all domains, stable-sort descending partial comparison, try scores satisfying !(score<threshold) until a solver returns Some (equivalent to score>=threshold for finite scores and finite threshold); else construct empty Escalate answer with context facts.
inverse: Domain answer preimage includes queries with failed global math and preceding eligible solvers declining; returned Route can be supplied by domain solve itself, so by is not a verified domain identity. Escalation admits zero domains, low scores or all eligible solvers None.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no macro expansion or semantic resolution. Finite synthetic CPU checks are not a proof. Frozen suites, corpus, teacher, GPU, allocation exhaustion and host IO failure injection were not run. No useful executable percent surrogate for categorical control/effects; unsupported gap, no 1/2/5/10% claim.
state: Global math wins over domains; finite equal scores preserve registration order. Exact threshold is eligible. Context logs register and route decisions; escalation does not contact teacher. Nonfinite/malformed scores are not validated.
